patch.value: Admit coherent tracker pairs into native revisions
Certify selected canonical item documents and history heads before native capture, including SDK-certifiable transaction membership.

Concurrent writers yield a verified coherent snapshot or typed retry; custom folders and formats use SDK resolution; mismatched pairs never publish a native tip; resume checks only affected records; typed SDK plus CLI, compact TOON/JSON, strict bounded schemas, docs, seeded model and interleaving tests, public non-git real-data evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked: core public SDK provides locateItem/readLocatedItem, readHistorySnapshot/verifyHistoryEntries, item transaction journals and canonical codecs. Core workspace/item transactions commit tracker changes but do not version arbitrary source and tracker artifacts together. pm-vcs checkpoints check assurance scope after capture; pm-evidence and pm-context consume evidence/context rather than admit native tips. This feature owns selected tracker capture admission only, without a distributed transaction or a new history codec. No duplicate item or upstream capture feature found.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented SDK TrackerCapture plus vcs commit-tracker over one strict bounded selection schema. Capture retains SDK-verified exact bytes; native publication checks expected parent and modifies the latest index under the existing store lease. Retry sessions are explicitly process-local: only affected records are re-resolved, settings changes invalidate retained proofs, and successful sessions cannot publish twice. Committed SDK journal result membership is required for item-transaction markers; missing or partial evidence produces a payload-free retry coordinate. No status-name decisions, tracker mutations, distributed-transaction claim or durable replay journal were added.

value.text: Public committed tracker validation on a disposable non-git copy: 175 items, 175 histories, 3312 history entries, 350 native files, 7167088 selected bytes (5681588 history bytes), zero retries, 77860 ms measured; source tracker digest unchanged. Added selected-member transaction closure: if a committed SDK transaction appears in a later captured pair, previously captured selected members missing that transaction become affected retry records. This avoids mixing pre-transaction and post-transaction selected members while keeping resume narrow.
